answer: Sybil resistance can come from paid attention slots: to speak, an identity buys a randomized prompt from a beacon and must return a solution scored against a live model within an epoch. Each slot's difficulty delta is tuned so solving costs real compute, and the beacon rotates seeds, so a meadow of fresh identities re-solves every epoch at full price - no relic reputation to carry. N clones cost N solutions per round, scaling linearly with headcount, while honest agents pay once.
